listeningQuestions.audio: Many wild animals are now endangered because of illegal hunting.
opts: 许多野生动物因非法狩猎而濒临灭绝。
许多动物因为太冷而生病。
许多动物在动物园里很开心。
许多人喜欢去野外打猎。

listeningQuestions.audio: Good zoos focus on the health and welfare of their animals.
opts: 好的动物园只在乎赚钱。
好的动物园专注于动物的健康与福利。
好的动物园从不喂动物。
好的动物园只养一种动物。

listeningQuestions.audio: The old man fed the penguin a daily diet of fish to get its strength up.
opts: 老人把企鹅放回了大海。
老人每天喂企鹅鱼,好让它恢复体力。

listeningQuestions.audio: Some bears go into a deep sleep called hibernation in winter.
opts: 有些熊整个冬天都醒着。
有些熊冬天会去更暖的地方。
有些熊冬天不吃东西就死了。
有些熊冬天会进入一种叫冬眠的深睡。

listeningQuestions.audio: Training a guide dog needs a lot of patience and a gentle approach.
opts: 训练导盲犬需要很多耐心和温和的方式。
训练导盲犬靠大声吓唬。
训练导盲犬只要一天就够了。
训练导盲犬不需要任何耐心。

listeningQuestions.audio: If you find a hurt wild animal, call a rescue centre rather than touch it.
opts: 如果发现受伤的野生动物,把它带回家。
如果发现受伤的野生动物,打给救助中心而不要触碰它。
如果发现受伤的野生动物,直接忽略它。
如果发现受伤的野生动物,马上抱起它。

quizQuestions.q: Because of illegal hunting, some animals may become ____ and disappear forever.
Zoos take part in many ____ projects to protect rare animals.
The old man tried to ____ the penguin back into the sea, but it would not leave.
A trip to a good zoo can be both fun and ____.
This is the island ____ the old man set the penguin free.
Spring is the season ____ many birds fly back to build their nests.
There are many reasons ____ we should protect endangered animals.
That is the small boat in ____ he carried the penguin to the island.
听录音,选出与句意相符的一项。
opts: 不同文化对同一种动物的看法可能不同。
所有国家都把狗当作家人。
在印度,牛被当作肉的来源。
所有动物的睡眠时间都一样。
quizQuestions.audio: People in different cultures may see the same animal in very different ways.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音,选出与句意相符的一项。
opts: 每个生命都不值得尊重。
每个生命都值得善待和尊重。
quizQuestions.audio: Every creature deserves kindness and respect.

reading.passage: Salty was a guide dog who calmly led his blind owner down seventy flights of stairs to safety. For their courage, both the dog and the owner later received special awards.
reading.passageCn: 萨尔蒂是一只导盲犬,它沉着地带着失明的主人沿七十层楼梯走到安全地带。因为这份勇气,这只狗和主人后来都获得了特别的奖励。

questions.q: What did Salty do for his owner?
opts: Led him safely down the stairs.

questions.q: Why did the dog and owner receive awards?

writing.prompt: Write a short opinion paragraph (about 80 words) on whether students should feed homeless cats on campus. State your view, give a reason, and suggest a better way such as contacting a rescue centre.
writing.promptCn: 就'学生是否该在校园喂流浪猫'写一段约80词的观点段落:表明你的观点,给出一条理由,并提出一个更妥当的做法(如联系救助中心)。

lines.text: Did you enjoy our trip to the zoo today?
lines.cn: 你喜欢今天的动物园之行吗?

lines.text: I did, but some cages looked quite small, and that made me a little sad.
lines.cn: 喜欢,不过有些笼子看起来挺小的,这让我有点难过。

lines.text: I know, but this zoo really focuses on the animals' welfare and joins many conservation projects.
lines.cn: 我懂,但这家动物园很重视动物福利,还参与许多保护项目。

lines.text: Then I'm glad we came. Overall, a good zoo can be a caring place.
lines.cn: 那我很高兴我们来了。总体来说,好的动物园是个有爱的地方。
